body:
Recommendation Build this first. It covers most cases on its own. {{F:leftovers}}.2 follows for the case it can't cover.
What

When a week ends, the items bought but not used go on a leftovers list.

How
  • List: worked out from the shopping list minus what the cooked recipes used.
  • Fresh food: items with a short shelf life are dropped after their days are up.
Depends On

3.6 (the findings) and 3.2 (the counts).

Risks

Recipes cooked but not marked as cooked make the list too long; {{F:leftovers}}.2 covers that case.
name: Keep List at Meal End
